mods.name: Ruckus Perks (Beta)
mods.author: Ruckus
mods.summary: A new Liar's Deck mode: earn perks and items by surviving the revolver.
mods.description:
Adds **Perks** to the Liar's Deck mode picker, next to Basic, Devil and Chaos.

Pick a perk when the match starts, then earn a stronger item every time you survive the revolver. Make it to 5 of 6 and you get **Bulletproof**.

**How it works**
- Host a friends-only or private lobby and pick **Perks** with the mode arrows.
- At the start, everyone picks 1 of 3 perks like Steady Hand, Tally, Thick Skin or Sharp Ears.
- Each pull you survive offers a better item: Peek, Stall, Card Swap, Mirror, Hand Swap, Loud Mouth, Reload or Pass the Gun.
- Press **Q** on your turn to use an item. You can hold two.

**Everyone at the table needs it** in Perks mode. Players without it are told where to get it and removed from the lobby. Basic, Devil and Chaos games stay exactly as normal.

versions.changelog: The perk panel and head icons now only show during a match.
New perk panel on the right side, clear of the chat. The pick screen now looks like the rest of the game. Bigger icons over heads. Sharp Ears is now a strong hunch rather than a sure thing.
Perk icons now float over each player's head, and one-time perks shatter when used. The pick screen is clickable, shows what each perk does, and you can press 1, 2 or 3.
Fix: Perks now turns on at Ruckus Solo tables.
Works with Ruckus Solo: play Perks against bots.
Perks is now its own Liar's Deck mode: pick it in the lobby next to Basic, Devil and Chaos. Plus fixes from review.
First beta: 4 starting perks, 8 items earned by surviving the revolver, and Bulletproof at 5 of 6.

mods.name: Ruckus Solo (Beta)
mods.author: Ruckus
mods.summary: Play Liar's Deck on your own against bots.
mods.description:
Adds **Solo** to the PLAY screen, right under Host Game and Lobby List.

**How it works**
- Click **Enter the Bar**, then **Solo**.
- Pick how many bots you want (1 to 3) and the mode, then press **Play**.
- A private table is set up and the match starts on its own. After a match you can press Start again.

Bots throw cards, bluff now and then, call liar and take their shot at the revolver like anyone else.

With **Ruckus Perks** installed you can also play the Perks mode against bots. Bots take the first perk they're offered and don't use items.

Solo plays Liar's Deck on Basic rules for now. Solo games never count toward rank.

versions.changelog: After a Solo match you go back to the main menu.
Bots take their revolver turn when they call wrong. New difficulty setting: Easy, Medium or Hard. Hard bots count cards and remember who lies. Solo now ends when you die.
Bots now animate like players: they hold their cards, throw, raise the gun and fall. Fixed a double revolver pull for bots.
First release: play Liar's Deck on your own against 1 to 3 bots.
